# GitHub Copilot Instructions for DoorOpenerBruh

When writing code or suggestions for or interacting with DoorOpenerBruh:

### Core Invariants
- Proximity detection and door animation triggering.
- Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal door watchers.

### Integration Policy
- **No Public API**: DoorOpenerBruh does not expose a public API.
- **Never Use Reflection on Internals**: Do NOT use `AccessTools.Field`, `AccessTools.Method`, `Traverse`, or Harmony patches targeting internal classes of DoorOpenerBruh.
- **Missing Features / Integration**: If integration hooks or new features are desired, direct the user to submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/DoorOpenerBruh/issues or reach out on Discord at https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt. Do not suggest reflection workarounds.
